_comment: This overlay's brain pointer. Holds no secret: the password (or token-command input) and the embedding key go in the gitignored kb.secret.env beside this file. See docs/brain-setup.md and docs/setups.md.
_comment_database_url: libpq DSN of the brain, e.g. 'host=db.example.com port=5432 dbname=agents user=agents_rw sslmode=require'. Never defaulted.
_comment_scope: shared (team or client brain; a local host is refused) or single-machine (one person, one machine, on purpose).
